Figure 63 Spaced-repetition Influence on Retention 
Furthermore, the derived correlation coefficient (R value) of 0.33; highlights a 
positive yet moderate correlation between spaced repletion and retention. The 
correlation suggests that as students perceive spaced repetition to be a more 
valued feature their intent to return to the application increases. However, with 
the applications multi-faceted nature, the exact influence of spaced repetition 
alone is difficult to isolate. 
The feedback given by the students provides user specific insights into the user 
experience with the proposed application. While reviewing these comments, 
multiple topics became apparent, such as a desire for the content to be more 
visually engaging or eye-catching, showing the users preference for an enhanced 
user interface design and content structure.
